name: Round LED surface light (flush mount)
description: Round surface-mounted LED light, Ø30 x 6 cm, ~24 W / 2000+ lm (common in Israeli stores as צמוד תקרה). Origin = top-centre, so position y = the underside it is screwed to. On when the room light is on (evening).

source.notes: Generic fixture size; pick a real one (e.g. 4000 K neutral white for a storage room).
